correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and normalizations were reconstructed. Flat normalized Fourier coefficients make the p translates of h orthonormal; the Gabor Gram factorizes exactly. The unique support zero follows from the prime cyclotomic polynomial and an explicit permutation check. Nontiling follows from cardinality divisibility. Nonproduct, nonpositive and both nonconstant-modulus claims have independent proofs. The quadratic Gauss-sum magnitude is derived directly. The packaged checker confirms finite instances but is not used for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The result gives an explicit uniform affirmative solution for every prime \(p\ge5\) to the exact six-condition existence question posed at the end of arXiv:1712.09120. It replaces the earlier product/full-support examples by a nonlinear chirped row-shift with nontiling support, so the contribution is structurally motivated rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
